title: Expand Grave Accord encounters and replay goals
body:
Story Campaign uses untimed reading, learned/proven/prepared techniques and scarce equipment income. Story-free Free Play retains rapid SP and mutations. Issued local saves preserve earned progress without inventing narrative proofs.

Ranger / Nela Venn adds committed bow draws, finite ready arrows, armed physical triplines and fixed Survey positions with limited charges. Crosswind, Linked Stakes and Long Survey change actual arrows, target quotas and firing positions. Campaign teaches one owned D− technique through a useful Drawn Line hit and a completed ordinary encounter. Free Play adds four bows and 54 nodes. Nela and civilian cart fitter Els Pell gain an English scene and optional letter; original art, icons, synthesized cues and 15 draft mechanical editions are integrated.

Current totals: 66 bosses, 11 classes, 594 class nodes, 44 weapons, 33 transformations and two General skills. Existing ten-class mechanics and art, plus all 37,500 prior analytical rows, are preserved.

Validation: **1202 tests**, TypeScript, 15 catalogs, checked word counts, 132 early-build and 41,250 SP-model cases, the production build, and 71 encounter / 268 survivor / 60 companion atlas contracts pass. [Exact source 1f3ef9223f98ef7017c058e872e3b2444ad0c699 CI](https://github.com/ProgrammingWithYagle/Bullet-Hell-Game-Open-AI-Contest-/actions/runs/41380260696) passed every job and step. Both frozen audiences pass 52 served-file checks and room/password/chat/host, ordinary, chapter, Bard, Swordsman and Summoner probes. Ranger adds eight art-byte samples and three-peer commitment, prepared-ground, pause, late-observer and cleanup checks. [Testing](http://127.0.0.1:5310/) · [Public interface](http://127.0.0.1:5311/).

This remains a draft. Alchemist, the larger campaign, complete personal arcs, later mastery, durable characters and further boss work remain unfinished. Fresh main-story prose is 5,425 English words, far from the five-million-word ambition. Rendered, device, language, motion, listening, literary and final human balance acceptance remain open. No production deployment, main merge or Windows replacement is included.
